annotations.text:
Direction: traffic-signal semantics on warm paper.
Green = go / pass, amber = caution / flagged, red = stop / wrong — the same language the road code itself uses, so colour carries meaning instead of decoration.
Space Grotesk for numerals (score, timer, counts) over system-ui body, which keeps long Kinyarwanda sentences native and legible on cheap Android screens.

Paywall: one free exam, then 1,000 RWF once, forever.
Payment is manual MoMo + an unlock code — no payment processor, no backend, nothing to integrate. The phone number and WhatsApp link are placeholders to fill in.
The upsell appears on the result screen (where the trial ends) and as a full wall on the next locked action.

Two directions not taken, kept as low-fi sketches so the choice is visible.
B reads as a machine under test but is cold and hard to read in long Kinyarwanda sentences. C feels like the printed booklet but serif at small sizes strains on cheap screens.
